title: VR Micro World Systems
description: A VR exploration of miniature, tabletop-scale worlds — designing the interaction and scale systems needed to view and manipulate an entire environment from a god's-eye perspective.

title: Micro Voxel World Simulation
description: A contained voxel world simulation — the chunking, generation, and interaction systems needed to make a small-scale voxel environment feel alive and editable in real time.

title: Advanced Multiplayer Systems Testing
description: A dedicated testbed for stress-testing replication, ownership, and RPC patterns under real network conditions — built to validate multiplayer systems before they ship, not after.

title: Multiplayer Vehicle Physics
description: Replicated vehicle physics for wartime-era multiplayer vehicles — synchronizing suspension, damage state, and driver input across the network without desync.

title: Physics-Based VR Combat Systems
description: Physics-driven melee and combat interactions in VR — grip, weight, and collision response built on real physics simulation instead of canned animation.

title: Multiplayer Inventory & Data Systems
description: A replicated inventory and data-management framework — built around ownership, prediction, and save/load persistence for networked multiplayer games.

title: Top-Down Multiplayer Defense Systems
description: A top-down multiplayer defense system — networked wave logic, unit placement, and shared-state coordination between players defending the same objective, with the networking layer written in C++.

title: Micro Planet Systems
description: Small-scale procedural planets with spherical gravity and traversal — the systems behind walking, building, and navigating a world that curves back on itself.

title: Planetary Rover Simulation
description: A rover traversal simulation with wheel-by-wheel suspension and terrain response — built to explore realistic locomotion over uneven, procedurally shaped ground, with gravity, driving, vehicle movement, and pawn multiplayer replication all written in C++.

title: Modular Spaceship Building System
description: A modular construction system for assembling spaceships piece by piece — snapping, structural logic, and part-dependency systems adapted from architectural building kits to vehicle design, with gravity, building, driving, vehicle movement, and pawn multiplayer replication all written in C++.

title: Real-Time Aerodynamics Simulation
description: A real-time aerodynamic force simulation — lift, drag, and control-surface response computed live in C++, bringing aerospace engineering fundamentals directly into the engine.

title: Modular Rocket Building System
description: A modular rocket construction system in the spirit of Kerbal Space Program — staging, part attachment, and thrust-to-mass systems built from the ground up.

title: Dynamic Mesh Generation for Base Building
description: A base-building system that generates its own geometry at runtime instead of snapping together pre-made pieces — walls, floors, and structural meshes built and welded procedurally as the player places them.
